about.p1: YOU Information Technology Company is specialized in providing integrated tech solutions. It was founded to support institutions and individuals in their digital journey by offering professional services that include software development, web design, hosting, and technical consulting.

about.p2: At YOU, we believe that technology should serve people and that digital transformation is not just about tools but a complete experience. Our mission is to design and build flexible, scalable, client-centered tech solutions.
about.p3: To be the first choice and trusted strategic partner in the Arab world for digital transformation by providing smart technologies that drive businesses toward the future.

service_details.steps_title: Essential Steps for Designing a Successful Website
service_details.step_2_desc: Select development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue).
service_details.step_3_desc: Choose the type of database (SQL or NoSQL) and design tables and relationships.
service_details.step_4_desc: Develop APIs and ensure performance and security of core operations.
service_details.step_5_desc: Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build the user interface and connect it to the backend.
service_details.step_6_desc: Conduct comprehensive tests using automated tools and unit testing.
service_details.step_7_desc: Analyze performance using tools like Google Lighthouse and optimize load time and responsiveness.
service_details.step_8_desc: Secure the site against common threats using HTTPS and data encryption.
service_details.step_9_desc: Deploy the website to the production server and ensure backup and recovery setup.
service_details.step_10_desc: Monitor site performance and stability, and update regularly to ensure continuity and improvement.
